R7|fnn-web-cleanup|swallow:serious-condition:fault @ host/native/web-host.lisp:147 trail: protected form can signal ['fault', 'os']

Hazard: The handlers route the original condition to the fence, then wrap that call so a failure of the install is discarded: owner.lisp:7410-7416 and 6196 (ignore-errors around fnn-owner-fence-service / fnn-owner-fault-service), mux.lisp:341 and 1697, web-host.lisp:147-150 (handler-case around fnn-owner-thread-escape with a nil clause). If the install itself signals, the service stays unfenced after an uncertain or faulted state. mux and web retain the original condition in a debt ledger that blocks the physical end (mux.lisp:471, web-host.lisp:1055), which only defers the failure to close; publish-captured and cold-settle retain nothing.
fix: Do not discard the install failure: record it on the same ledger and make the actor boundary re-signal it, or last-resort stop the process with the fence exit code (fnn-exit 3 / 4) when the install fails. Keep the original condition in the record.
notes: Fixed at 65b9a3077: fnn-owner-install-or-end (owner.lisp) ends the process with the original condition's ACL2 exit code when a fence/fault install signals; used at fnn-owner-publish-captured, fnn-owner-cold-settle (now classified by fnn-owner-thread-escape), fnn-mux-cleanup-attempt, fnn-mux-close-wake's escalation, fnn-web-cleanup. Keys gone from --check on lane/lock-owner-class at 65b9a3077: R7|fnn-owner-cold-settle, R7|fnn-owner-publish-captured, R7|fnn-mux-cleanup-attempt, R7|fnn-web-cleanup; none added. Remaining: R7|fnn-mux-close-wake (mux.lisp:1680 handler records the condition on the debt ledger via fnn-mux-cleanup-debt and escalates after the loop; the checker cannot see the deferred escalation, so the key needs a checker-verified failure-scope contract, outside this lane). natives_owed: tests/test_native_slow_disk.py (checkpoint publication), mux/web close paths via tests/test_native_outside_in.py.

Last key closed at b731f701e by a checker model fix, not a row for the site: _deferred_dolist_vars + contracts escalation_wrappers (fnn-owner-install-or-end, verified from source) let R7 see that fnn-mux-close-wake's post-loop dolist escalates every captured condition. Key R7|fnn-mux-close-wake|swallow:serious-condition:fault gone from --check on lane/lock-owner-class at b731f701e; all five original keys gone, none added.
